calibration_sources: Azure OpenAI / Foundry Multi-Region Load Balancing with APIM & DataZone / Global Provisioned Spillover
AWS Bedrock Cross-Region Inference Profiles & Multi-Region Resilience Architecture
The Tail at Scale (Dean & Barroso): P95 Request Hedging for Grey-Failure Mitigation in Distributed Serving

workload.enterprise_scenario: Mission-Critical Global Financial & E-Commerce AI Platform (400 RPS Peak, 18B Tokens/Month across Multi-Region Endpoints)
workload.target_sla: Effective Availability >= 99.99% (<= 52.6 min downtime/yr), Failover RTO <= 10 ms, Brownout P99 TTFT <= 550 ms
workload.key_resilience_principles: Never leave a 100% duplicate PTU/GPU cluster sitting idle in Active-Passive standby; use 60/40 Active-Active regional splitting + Global PAYGO burst + P95 tail-latency hedging.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 单区域单云端点裸奔部署 (如仅配 East US 单点 · 区域波动即引发全局雪崩)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Single-Region Single-Endpoint Deployment (No Cross-Region Failover)
tiers.ha_architecture: 100% Traffic Pinned to a Single Region Endpoint (Vulnerable to Regional Capacity Brownouts & 503s)
tiers.recommended_for: Non-critical internal dev/test environments only; unacceptable for customer-facing production.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 传统主备 1:1 双倍静态预留 (备区 PTU/GPU 100% 空转待命 · 成本翻倍且 DNS 切换慢)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Active-Passive 1:1 Duplicate Idle Standby Cluster (50% Standby Waste, 45s DNS RTO)
tiers.ha_architecture: 100% Active Primary Region + 100% Idle Standby Secondary Region Switched via DNS Health Check
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for LLM infra: paying $28K/mo for an idle secondary GPU/PTU pool wastes 50% of budget.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 同云多区域双活负载池 (60%/40% 分流) + Global/DataZone PAYGO 毫秒级溢出
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Active-Active Multi-Region Weighted Pool (60/40) + Instant Global/DataZone Spillover
tiers.ha_architecture: 60% Region A + 40% Region B Active-Active Base Pool + AI Gateway 4.5ms Failover to Global PAYGO Burst
tiers.recommended_for: 90% of enterprise production workloads: achieves multi-region HA with 0% idle standby waste via Global/DataZone burst.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 跨云/混合双活 + P95 尾延迟对冲请求 (650ms 触发并发备份请求) + 向量库双活
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Active-Active Multi-Cloud/Hybrid + P95 Tail-Latency Request Hedging (99.995% SLA)
tiers.ha_architecture: Multi-Region/Multi-Provider Active-Active + P95 (650ms) TTFT Hedging (5% Overhead) + Geo-Replicated RAG
tiers.recommended_for: Mission-critical banking, trading & global customer platforms needing 99.995% SLA and immunity to grey-failure brownouts.
